[[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] won '''Division 1 season 2001/2002''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 66 points. The title was decided in the very final game of the season when Lyon defeated erstwhile championship leaders [[RC Lens|Lens]] at [[Stade Gerland]]. Lyon had to win the match to take the title, and won 3–1, ending Lens's title dream. It was Lyon's first league championship, and it began their record seven successive league titles.
